verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a code-sandbox product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a Vercel-managed service: microVMs run in Vercel regions, are managed from the Vercel Dashboard, and are metered for billing. Access tokens for non-Vercel environments only let external systems call the hosted service; they are not a way to self-host the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
